output.summary: The randomized classroom experiment supports an imprecise practiced Exercise 1 delayed-test gain and improved observed post-mistake recovery, with an internal 3.1-versus-3.2-point discrepancy. Registration and preregistered hypotheses are mentioned, but a preregistered primary endpoint is not established, preventing evidence grade A.
